---
name: changelog-draft
description: Draft a changelog entry from merged pull requests when the user prepares a release or asks what changed since the last tag.
---

# Changelog draft

1. List the pull requests merged since the previous release tag.
2. Sort them into Added, Changed, Fixed and Removed.
3. Rewrite each title as a user-facing sentence and drop internal refactors.

Follow references/style.md for tense and wording.
